Experimental_Design.Conditions: self-matching, self-mismatching, friend-matching, friend-mismatching, stranger-matching, stranger-mismatching (switch assignment: self->stranger, friend->self, stranger->friend)

Block_Structure.Practice_trials: 9 practice trials (one per condition) in Breaking; 6 practice trials in Association
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 648 formal trials per participant in Breaking (8 blocks x 81 = 9 conditions x 72) + 9 practice; Association: variable formal trials (until 6 consecutive correct per shape) + 6 practice

exp1.detail: Rebuilt 2026-08 stage 4 from the author's E-Merge aggregate CSV exports (previous in-repo Exp1 five-file set was erroneous AssoMatc_Self task data - 31 participants, person+reward stimuli, collected 2013-07/08, not any experiment of this paper; archived in *_Raw/AssoMatc_Self_archive/). 2026-09-01 txt-verified rebuild (v2): data source switched to the 6 E-Merge txt exports converted from edat2/emrg2 in *_Raw/ (RawData_Exp1/Exp2); author aggregate CSVs verified value-by-value against the txt with 0 differences (2_Code/wang2016_verify/verify_merge_vs_csv.py; the CSV lacks the 6 association practice rows and, for Exp2, the 9 breaking practice rows - both present in the txt). Data: 21 participants (IDs 3-24 missing 23; paper N=21, 3 male/18 female, 19-27 yrs, M=22; txt headers). Two phases: Association (Part 1; actually a 3AFC task: shape + three labels on screen, keys b/n/m = label positions 1/2/3, CorrectAnswer = position key of the shape's assigned label; 6 practice + variable formal trials until 6 consecutive correct per shape; paper text describes match/mismatch judgment but implementation is 3AFC - see Issue 3) and Breaking (Part 2; 9 practice + 8 blocks x 81 = 9 conditions x 72; keys n/m with per-participant counterbalanced match key, paper says Z/M). Clean: Label/Matching now filled for Association (label = shape's assigned identity label, English; Matching = Matching for all Association trials since the correct label is by definition the assigned one); Block (1-8)/Trial (1-81) and CorrResponse (= CorrectAnswer) added for Breaking formal rows. Matching = rule B (new assignment: self->stranger, friend->self, stranger->friend), verified trial-by-trial against txt CorrectAnswer/YesNoResp (0 violations). On-screen label text was Chinese (you/pengyou/shengren) or lowercase English per participant; Label/Origin columns store English (Exp1 capitalized). ACC 1/0 with no response -> NA. Paper statistics approximately reproduced (match-RT RM-ANOVA F=43.02 vs paper 43.29 with all 21 participants; error F=6.66 vs 7.65; all paper dfs (2,38) imply N=20 analyzed while paper reports 21 - see 3_Reports/Verifying_original_results_issues.md (Issue 3)).
